definitions.gloss: to consider; to examine; to study; to review
definitions.explanation: To carefully think about or investigate something before making a decision. Frequently used in business and formal contexts, and sometimes used as a polite way to postpone or decline a request.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧させて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please let me think about it a bit more.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧して⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{回答|かいとう}します→回答する：18400_kaitousuru⟧。
examples.english: I'll review the proposal internally and then respond.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧、⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧した⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{来年度|らいねんど}→来年度：28221_rainendo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: After careful consideration by the committee regarding the introduction of the new system, it was decided to implement it from next fiscal year.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the most common business Japanese words. In practice, ⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧します is often used as a polite way to avoid saying no directly. When someone says ⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧します in response to a request, it can mean genuine consideration, but it can also be a soft refusal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {検討|けんとう}する⟦{余地|よち}→余地：07612_yochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there is room for consideration)
- ⟦{前向|まえむ}き→前向き：10073_maemuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{検討|けんとう}する (to consider positively)
- ⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{検討|けんとう}する (to consider carefully)
- ⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (result of the review)
- ⟦{検討|けんとう}{中|ちゅう}→検討中：08718_kentouchuu⟧ (under consideration)

NOTE FOR LEARNERS:
Be aware that ⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧します does not always mean the matter will truly be considered. In business, it is often a diplomatic way to decline without saying no.
